decision: Retain a research-only equal-cap candidate. Full-window modeled net rises in all 36 comparisons, but maximum dollar drawdown rises in all 36 and later full-HIP-3-fee net worsens in all 12 stress cases. Recorded/adverse/original-exit net improves from 96.119669 to 369.087681 USD, drawdown from 198.691884 to 288.189294 USD and later net from -87.438147 to -52.429503 USD. Average entry-notional exposure roughly doubles despite the unchanged summed caps. Next qualify exact current quote capacity, rounding and fee costs before preparing an inactive prospective/allocation proposal. Do not fit intermediate weights or change live sizing.
falsifier: Changed source hashes, failed original/event control parity, nonproportional quantities or cashflows, incorrect fee/funding clocks, incompatible per-entry cap binding, inadequate shared cash, changed lifecycle eligibility, or failed independent/archive replay. Current or historical depth insufficiency would weaken the fixed-price execution assumption; future profitability requires separate independent evidence.
hypothesis: A single equal-route-cap allocation at the unchanged summed 7500 USD notional budget can quantify the current unequal allocation trade-off while preserving all seven routes, leverage and lifecycle unit-price contracts.
limitations: The benchmark was chosen after observing concentration on already explored history; its 36 sensitivities are not independent experiments or untouched out-of-sample validation.
All entries, exits and unit prices remain fixed. Changed quantities do not establish executable liquidity, venue lot rounding, dynamic impact, queue priority or actual client fills.
Summed caps are fixed, but average deployed entry-notional exposure and initial margin roughly double; this is neither constant-risk nor constant-deployed-capital sizing.
The original and one-second-plus-friction sampled SNDK stop controls remain separate. The inherited sampled fill was validated at its original quantity and needs changed-size qualification.
Later adverse price PnL remains negative before costs, and later full-fee stress worsens; larger full-window net is not evidence that later weakness has been repaired.
SNDK supplies most equal-cap full-window net; excluding the three largest positive marked-day contributions leaves -27.508252 USD as descriptive concentration arithmetic.
Completed-candle marks, adverse intrabar proxies and historical fee/source qualifications remain inherited. Current metadata cannot retrospectively establish historical execution.
High confidence concerns accounting and reproducibility, medium concerns the exposure interpretation, and low concerns future profitability or actual changed-size execution.
The post-result exposure decomposition adds no allocation variants; its interval arithmetic is independently checked in SQL.
Coverage concerns the pure allocation module and focused fixtures, not the entire project or all source/archive I/O.
No live profile, strategy, cap, leverage, TUI or trading/reporter process lifecycle changed. The tracked processes remain absent; account state was not refreshed.
The sealed September 8-22 SNDK/Brent experiment remains unopened. The next study measures quote capacity only, without replaying its strategy outcomes.
